generateQR.name: generateQR
generateQR.description: Generates a QR code via window.QREngine.create(config), injects the SVG into targetId's innerHTML, and triggers 'result' with {svg, info, analysis, error} (or 'error' on failure).

downloadQR.name: downloadQR
downloadQR.description: Downloads the last generated QR code. format 'svg' calls qr.downloadSVG(); format 'png' calls qr.downloadPNG(px).

uploadLogo.name: uploadLogo
uploadLogo.description: Reads an image File (from a file input change event) as a data URL and triggers 'result' with { dataUrl } (or 'error' on failure).

setAuthCookies.name: setAuthCookies
setAuthCookies.description: Sets access and refresh token cookies from the login response

loginUser.name: loginUser
loginUser.description: Logs in a user against Supabase, sets auth cookies, and redirects to dashboard.

createDynamicCode.name: createDynamicCode
createDynamicCode.description: Creates a dynamic short code row in Supabase (codes table) for the given destination and triggers 'result' with the short URL (https://qr.engineer/{id}) or 'error' on failure. Mirrors generateQR's event-based conventions.

loadMyCodes.name: loadMyCodes
loadMyCodes.description: Fetches the current user's dynamic codes (with scan counts) from Supabase and triggers 'result' with the rows or 'error' on failure. Mirrors createDynamicCode's event-based conventions.

startProCheckout.name: startProCheckout
startProCheckout.description: Reads the qr_access_token cookie and POSTs it to the QR billing Worker to create a Stripe checkout session, then redirects to the returned checkout URL.

qrSvg.name: qrSvg
qrSvg.description: Encodes text into a QR code and renders it as an SVG string. Supports module shapes: square, rounded, dots.
